The animal with distinctive black and white stripes is the zebra.

Regarding the cloud computing security issues in the text, the primary vulnerability is the lack of proper network access controls for public cloud data storage. Specifically, the e-commerce platform failed to configure restrictions on its storage buckets, leading to unrestricted access. This misconfiguration allowed unauthorized entities to access the data, resulting in data leaks. This highlights a critical failure in identity and access management (IAM) and network security policies within the cloud environment.
